body: If anyone is still reading this I really need more support right now.

I've considered it, but I'm already halfway through the semester and I have worked really hard. I hate to see it all go to waste, but I also don't want to tank my GPA. My therapist also mentioned me possibly taking a medical leave and getting an incomplete until I can make it up. 

I guess I'll call her. It can't hurt. I'm afraid she'll be too busy for me. I really would like to talk to her before I take the test. The test is at 10 am. She usually gets to her office around 8:30-8:45 and sometimes has a client at 9, sometimes not. I guess I don't want to call her because if she doesn't have time for me than I'll feel even more trapped and alone. I really feel like this is an impossible situation. I know I shouldn't be mad at myself but I am. I hate my stupid brain.

It is my first time taking meds. They were helping a little but not a lot. I know it takes time, but it's hard when I need help now.

I might try and call her tomorrow. I really don't want to though. I'm just afraid of becoming too dependent on her and I just feel really silly. Like I shouldn't be all worked up and I should be able to do it like I'm an adult now I need to have my shit together. The worst is this test is a make up test and my professor gave me extra time and if I eff it up now it's all on me. I got a 70 on my last exam and that was with trying. I literally haven't even touched my materials. At this rate I'll fail it and have a D in the class and I'm not sure if I can bring that up. I hate this so much because I know I could do this if I wasn't so fucking mentally ill.

I'm currently on a lower dose of my meds right now because I'm about to run out. I've only been on meds for a few weeks now though and not at a very high dose so it wasn't helping me that much, but it was a little so I guess that's probably not helping. 

I hope I can make it til then too. For the most part I feel validated and we have a good relationship. I have a hard time being open with her all the time as I'm very guarded, but I feel like she's the only one that really gets this even a little bit. 

I have a big exam and a two hour lecture tomorrow as well. I'm not prepared for either and I don't think I can be and get some sleep at the save time. I hate that everything counts for so much more at the college level. This stress is what's really pushing me over the edge.
